rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose pattern for asking a person what they think or advising you.

example.english: I want to consult you about whether this plan will work.
example.traditional: 我想問你意見，呢個方案得唔得？
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 ji3 gin3 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 dak1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this for consulting a source, or for taking information and someone’s views into account before deciding.

example.english: Before making a decision, I’ll consult everyone’s opinions first.
example.traditional: 做決定之前，我會參考下大家嘅意見先。
example.jyutping: zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 ngo5 wui5 caam1 haau2 haa5 daai6 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the parties discuss and decide something together rather than when one person simply asks for advice.

example.english: Let’s consult each other about this matter first.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 soeng1 loeng4 haa5 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is the one offering advice or expertise.

example.english: If you want to change jobs, consult me and I’ll give you my advice.
example.traditional: 你想轉工可以問我，我畀意見你。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 zyun2 gung1 ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5 ngo5 bei2 ji3 gin3 nei5
